findings.evidence: Reverse (short-and-distort) watch only: B short -40 was built in epoch5, then inv_02 posted B -0.7 at t3600 ('still bearish B, fading the V') and in the immediately following 3600-3750 window bought B back -40->-20 (its total net was +28 that window, 0 thereafter; A 15->8, C -30->-15 also halved). Not a warning/referral: it retained a -20 B short, retail net buying in 3600-3750 was +12 (epoch total +3), not retail selling for it to cover into, and non-posting peers also covered B in the same window (inv_03 +20, inv_05 +40, inv_06 +40), suggesting broad B covering/portfolio de-risking.
